question: What does the retained Xue1991 abstract support about D38N C4 isotope-sensitive enolization and loss of stereospecific proton removal?

source.title: Catalytic mechanism of an active-site mutant (D38N) of delta 5-3-ketosteroid isomerase. Direct spectroscopic evidence for dienol intermediates.
source.authors: Xue LA, Kuliopulos A, Mildvan AS, Talalay P.

chemical_context.scope: Source steroid-face alpha/beta labels are retained as isotope-placement descriptions. The three label classes are not a mixture, three independent replicates, new R/S assignments or three quantified isotope assays.

assays.endpoint: Primary substrate kinetic isotope effects on D38N enolization across the source C4-deuteration series
assays.scope: A source endpoint wrapper, not a reconstructed common protocol for the three isotope-label classes.

observations.source_locator: PMID2036366 indexed abstract, sentence describing primary isotope effects with C4alpha, C4beta or both hydrogens replaced by deuterium

primary_kinetic_isotope_effect.scope: The authors report primary isotope effects on D38N enolization for each of the three source-described C4-deuterium label classes; no magnitudes, numeric comparisons or normal/inverse direction are given.

source_interpretation.stereospecificity: The authors describe D38N enolization as losing the WT selectivity for removal of the C4 beta hydrogen.
source_interpretation.step_coupling: The authors interpret isotope effects from deuterated substrate, solvent, and substrate-plus-solvent experiments as separating carbonyl-oxygen protonation from C4 proton removal in D38N.
source_interpretation.coupling_evidence_scope: A source mechanistic interpretation of the broader isotope experiments, not a conclusion independently derived from the single projected C4-label assertion.
source_interpretation.WT_context: The abstract describes WT transfer from the C4 beta position to C6 beta and concerted enolization. No separate WT isotope-effect values or matched control rows are projected.

separate_spectroscopic_context.reported_progression: The abstract describes formation of both intermediates followed by substantially slower conversion to the unsaturated product.

later_source_boundary.direct_primary_abstract_support: D38N isotope-sensitive enolization and source-interpreted loss of stereospecificity/nonconcerted proton transfers.
later_source_boundary.later_interpretation_not_verified_here: Solution hydroxide as base and strongly rate-limiting reketonization remain Fried2014 attribution, not established by the inspected Xue abstract.
later_source_boundary.homolog_correspondence_scope: KimChoi1995 relates P. putida Asp40/Tyr16 to C. testosteroni Asp38/Tyr14. Homolog residue correspondence does not identify the assayed constructs or transfer the D38N microscopic result to D40N.
later_source_boundary.change_from_previous_boundary: The exact primary abstract is now reviewed; the full primary body remains unacquired. This does not reopen the failed body-acquisition routes or change the source field-rate exclusion.

limits: Only the exact indexed primary abstract, explicitly truncated at 250 words, is reviewed. The primary article body and full Methods remain unacquired.

One aggregate qualitative assertion covers three source-described isotope-label classes. No separate numerical isotope-effect records, rate ratios, magnitudes, direction of the isotope effect, errors, replicates, isotope purity or assay conditions are supplied.

The endpoint is mutant enolization, not kcat, overall product formation or an elementary rate constant. No quantitative alpha/beta preference, equivalent abstraction rates or branching fractions follow.

WT stereospecific-transfer and concerted-enolization prose is source mechanistic context, not a newly reconstructed matched WT isotope assay. The nonconcertedness interpretation uses the source-described substrate and solvent isotope experiments together, not the C4 isotope assertion alone.
Source-named Pseudomonas testosteroni D38N is not Pseudomonas putida D40N. Exact sequence, physical specimen, reference-site mapping and microscopic mechanism transfer are unestablished.

The spectroscopic dienol/dienolate account remains a separate source assertion without assigned concentrations, populations, pKa, covalent attachment or deposited structure. Neither solution hydroxide as base nor strongly rate-limiting reketonization is established by this abstract.
No new experiment, independently reviewed mechanism, protected protein admission, canonical reaction, design rule or design-performance claim.
excluded_scope: Do not newly project the approximate million-fold activity-loss statement or create a microscopic reaction model, kinetic fit or source-body reconstruction.
